description: This file defines the RemotePlugin class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, specifically in the Rust namespace. It declares the class's interface, including constructors, destructors, methods for initialization, deinitialization, communication, and control of a remote plugin, as well as private members for managing process and communication state. The class appears to facilitate interaction with a Rust-based plugin system over a socket server, with conditional compilation for different Thunder framework versions.
